assumptions: Quantities are NET of waste; the waste column applies the factors listed at the end.
Exterior walls 2x6 at 16" o.c., 8'-0" high; interior partitions 2x4 at 16" o.c.
Roof is 6/12 throughout with 16" eave and 12" gable overhangs (slope factor 1.118).
House 1,824 SF and garage 991 SF are taken from the plan title block rather than re-measured.
Interior partition length (~175 LF) was scaled from the 1/4" plan; no partition dimension string is given.
Garage assumed unconditioned: no wall insulation, 9'-0" wall height assumed for siding.
Appliances assumed owner-supplied; only rough-ins are carried.
Basement 'future' bedroom/family room/bath are shown but excluded from finish scope (bath is stub-in only).
open_questions: Garage door widths: floor plan labels three 9'-0" doors; right-side elevation labels one 10'-0" — confirm final sizes.
Laundry closet 3-0 opening: bifold, double, or cased opening?
Finish selections (flooring split, counters, cabinet line) not on drawings — needed to price finishes beyond allowances.
Fire separation detail at house/garage wall and ceiling (gyp type/thickness) not called out.
Optional cathedral ceiling: base bid scissor-truss vault or flat? "ridge of optional cathedral ceiling" shown.
No electrical plan provided — device/fixture counts unavailable.
No mechanical/plumbing riser sheets — HVAC and supply/DWV are allowance-level.
No reinforcing called out for foundation walls, footings or slabs — confirm rebar/mesh with the engineer before pricing steel.
Excavation quantity depends on existing grades and the walkout cut — no site/grading plan provided.
Basement 'future' bedroom, family room and bath: finish scope excluded (stub-in only) — confirm base bid.
Furnace and water heater sizes not given (no mechanical sheet).
Garage door width conflict: the right side elevation labels a 10'-0" door while the floor plan dimension string gives three 9'-0" openings totalling 38'-0". Confirm before ordering.
Gutters and downspouts are not shown on any elevation — confirm scope and linear footage.
Drip edge is not called out in the wall detail although felt, ice-and-water and shingles are.
Garage wall height is not dimensioned; 9'-0" assumed for siding and sheathing quantities.
Whether the garage walls and ceiling are insulated (garage doors are specified insulated, walls are not called out).
Shake-pattern gable accent: confirm it is a vinyl shake product and not a painted field, and confirm colours.
Truss type split (32'-0" regular vs scissor, 28'-0", 10'-0") needs the manufacturer's truss layout to be quantified properly.
Damp-proofing / waterproofing on the foundation wall is still not called out (the wall detail gives 4" footing tile but no wall coating).
